premise.claim: When a member Pod of a Ready RoleInstance goes away because its node failed / got disconnected, the controller only re-creates the same-name Pod and never recreates the RoleInstance; once RoleInstanceReady flips False, wasInstanceReady()==false && hasRecentRestart()==false disables RecreateRoleInstanceOnPodRestart permanently (issue #542).
premise.evidence: results/unit-base.txt: both premise contract tests FAIL on base fd160cc (no deletionTimestamp trigger; readiness gate closed) and PASS on head 8f63c86 (results/unit-head.txt). Integration corroboration: base envtest spec 'should not recreate during initial creation (instance not yet Ready)' passes on base, i.e. the base suite asserted the gated behavior (results/envtest-base-guard-old-behavior.txt).

integration.cmd: KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS="${KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS:-$(setup-envtest use 1.31.0 -p path 2>/dev/null)}" go test ./test/envtest/testcase/restart_policy/ -count=1 -timeout 20m -args -ginkgo.focus 'Durable RoleInstance recovery' -ginkgo.json-report=$GINKGO_REPORT

match: does not recreate ordinary Pending members before first Ready
does not delete a new UID under an old list, then retries its explicit failure
retries three fresh member-Pod sets before first Ready without changing the RI UID
restarts the whole instance after an individually repaired member fails
drains a terminating member once and resumes only after its finalizer is released
